The Always Clean Mop and a dual water reservoir loaded with ozonated water refresh the 11.4-inch mop in real time at 170 RPM, while 1 kg of downward pressure mimics hand scrubbing to remove stubborn stains. Cleaning large amounts of liquid waste is not recommended, as it risks damaging the robot.

The station handles auto emptying, washing, refilling, heated air drying, Eco-Clean Ozone treatment, waste water collection and detergent dispensing, with LCD touch control, a sealed dust bag and charging 20% faster than the previous generation.
Powerful 8000 Pa suction deep-cleans carpets and hard floors, effortlessly removing hair and deep-seated dirt. Actual performance may vary based on floor type and dust level.
The sleek square design lets S1 Pro reach hard-to-reach areas such as edges and corners for a thorough deep clean.
Inspired by the sleek lines of elite sports cars, it is more than a home appliance and adds a refined touch to your living space.
Use a 2.4GHz router, or a dual-band router configured to support the 2.4GHz band. The robot does not support the 5GHz band.
